# Engineering notes

## Context and scope

Record the date, environment, affected service, recent change, investigation owner, and whether this is an intentional exercise or an unexpected incident.

## Observations and evidence

For each test record its timestamp and timezone, question, exact command, relevant output, and interpretation. Distinguish observed output from expected output. Sanitize credentials and unnecessary identifiers before publishing.

## Hypothesis log

Record the initial hypothesis, evidence supporting it, evidence contradicting it, and why the next test was chosen. Preserve meaningful corrections.

## Recovery and verification

Record what was proposed, what was actually applied, by whom, and what demonstrated recovery. A published fix is not a verified recovery.

## Lessons and remaining questions

Explain the reusable concept, assistance received, unresolved uncertainty, and follow-up actions. Link the RCA only after the cause is supported.
